name: Aero Commander 100 Darter / Lark
summary: Four-seat, strut-braced high-wing with fixed tricycle gear designed by Volaircraft and sold by Aero Commander in 1965–71; the Lark Commander adds a swept fin.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four in a smooth cowl
fuselage: Four-seat cabin with a door each side

tellTales: Strut-braced four-seat high wing on fixed tricycle gear
Upright fin on early examples, swept fin on the later version
Small, simple airframe with a rounded cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: Both are four-seat strut-braced high-wings on fixed tricycle gear; the Darter has a plainer cabin and tail, with an upright fin on early examples, while the 172 has a swept fin with a long dorsal fillet.
The Darter is smaller with a smaller cowl; the 182 has a deeper, blunter cowl and bigger cabin.
The Darter is a high-wing with a strut each side; the PA-28 is a low-wing without struts.
